about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: Systems Engineer and current Master's candidate in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science. I combine extensive experience in the design, development, deployment, and maintenance of scalable software with advanced knowledge in Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Analytical Architectures, and Language Models. Specialized in the complete data lifecycle, from the engineering pipeline (ETL/Big Data) to the integration of predictive models into production microservices.
about.paragraph2: I am an honest, committed, responsible person with a drive for self-improvement who fulfills my duties. Capable of facing new challenges in both professional and personal life. Willing to grow in knowledge and acquire new skills to advance in my career and as a person. I am entrepreneurial, capable, and willing to take on new challenges, meet goals, and assume commitments even when it means using new tools to achieve the objective.
about.paragraph3: My key differentiator is my hybrid profile: I combine solid production experience (cloud, DevOps, backend) with advanced knowledge in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Computer Vision. I can train models and deploy them robustly.
